description: Shared Environment Variable operations omit statuses the live API returns (live-verified 2026-08-13): environment.getSharedEnvVar answers 404 `id_not_found` for an unknown id; environment.updateSharedEnvVariable answers 404 `id_not_found` when any referenced id is unknown (NOT a `failed[]` envelope entry); environment.deleteSharedEnvVariable answers 404 `id_not_found` when an id is already gone (the idempotent-delete path catches this); environment.createSharedEnvVariable answers 409 `existing_key_and_target` when the key already exists for the selected targets (NOT a `failed[]` envelope entry). Add the statuses so the generator attaches typed NotFound/Conflict errors to these operations.
